name: Cetirius no Yuuutsu
source:
This is a voiced CG collection showing a slice of a beautiful princess' 
erotic life at her palace seized by monsters. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE245029.html]DLsite English[/url]]

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE245029.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
